speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing postmenopausal bleeding and have an adnexal mass detected. To begin our evaluation, can you tell me how old you are and how many months have passed since your last menstrual period?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial Hyperplasia (likely secondary to an estrogen-secreting ovarian tumor such as a Granulosa Cell Tumor).

I have noted your age and the 2-month history of bleeding. Given the combination of postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass, we must rule out malignancy. REQUEST TEST: Pelvic Ultrasound with Doppler to characterize the adnexal mass and assess endometrial thickness.
